My contribution

Following the story. Shaping the image.

My work on Imposter crossed investigative research and production. I traced online identities, connected accounts and pursued leads within a complex story, then contributed cinematography, lighting and the building of scenes for filming.

The close-up above comes from a sequence I personally lit and shot. It is a precise example of my camera and lighting work within the series.
